sourceRefs.excerpt: Loyalty Bonus While the policy is in-force, we will pay an annual loyalty bonus at the end of each policy year, starting from the sixth policy anniversary. During premium payment term, loyalty bonus will be paid in accor

catalogWarnings: TM Atlas Wealth is cataloged as a supported V1 product. The parser captures split SGD / premium-payment-term-25 Basic Death and Advanced Death corridors with executable regular-premium routing, published initial bonus tiers, annual loyalty bonus with the published bounded adjustment-factor formula during the premium payment term and the flat post-term rate thereafter, account-fee-rate modeling for the initial and policy charges, recurring single premium and top-up charges into the Accumulation Units Account, the after-first-policy-year regular-premium variation start gate with the published SGD minimum regular-premium table, the commencement-date recurring-single-premium resumption gate after premium holiday, the 25-year surrender charge on the Initial Units Account, the nil-charge one-off partial-withdrawal path with the published second-policy-year accumulation-account gate, post-term Initial Units Account access, S$500 minimum withdrawal amount, and S$3,000 minimum account value, and the published phase-specific dividend cash-payout account restrictions through the manual distribution-mode assumption surface.
Dividend cash payouts are modeled through the manual distribution-mode assumption surface with the published SGD 50 minimum payout threshold and 30-day record-date lead time.

Recurring single premium stays blocked after a premium-holiday event until an explicit recurring-single-premium resumption is entered and the regular premium amount is restored to the commencement-date amount.
Minimum regular-premium increase / reduction amounts remain informational only because the summary leaves those insurer-defined.

Basic Death keeps Monthly Protection Charge metadata-only, while the Advanced Death variant models the published current death-benefit estimate, first-policy-year accrual, policy-year-2 settlement, policy-value valuation basis, irreversible downgrade after failed deduction, and static current multi-life last-life handling.
Premium-holiday lapse behavior, change-of-life-assured administration, regular withdrawal, selected-fund residual-value conditions, credit-card charge, and other corridors remain informational only.
Structured extraction validated against the TM Atlas Wealth product summary text layer.
This partial template models the SGD / premium-payment-term-25 (Basic Death) corridor only.

This partial template models 12-month initial-versus-accumulation routing, the published 25-year initial bonus tiers, the published initial charge and policy charge through executable account fee rates, recurring single premium and top-up routing into the Accumulation Units Account, the after-first-policy-year regular-premium variation start gate with the published SGD minimum regular-premium table, the published 25-year surrender charge on the Initial Units Account, and the phase-specific dividend cash-payout account restrictions through the manual distribution-mode assumption surface.
Recurring single premium events before policy month 13 or below the published monthly-equivalent minimum of S$50 are blocked; insurer-defined increase / reduction minimums remain informational only.

Recurring single premium stays blocked during premium holiday until an explicit recurring-single-premium resumption is entered and the regular premium amount is restored to the committed commencement-date amount.
Minimum regular-premium increase / reduction amounts remain informational only because the summary leaves those insurer-defined.

This product supports distribution-paying fund elections. V1 seeds reinvest by default; cash payout requires a manual annual distribution-yield assumption, and payouts below the published minimum annual cash-payout amount of S$50 remain reinvested.
Cash payout elections for dividend-paying funds should be submitted at least 30 days before the record date.

Advanced Death selection, Monthly Protection Charge, change-of-life-assured administration, premium-holiday lapse behavior, regular withdrawal, credit-card charge, and non-SGD or non-25-year corridors remain metadata-only.
